cognitive_contract.label: Justify / formal deductive proof (Advanced Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Formulate rigorous deductive justifications, invariant impossibility arguments, or extremal equality conditions across advanced Olympiad structures to evaluate protected claim W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to establish the complete deductive necessity without prompting the invariant coloring or descent mechanism.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the coloring scheme, divisibility property, or substitution variables without completing the contradiction or equality proof.

slots.X: proving that an 8x8 chessboard with one corner square removed cannot be tiled by 1x3 straight trominoes
slots.Y: 8x8 chessboard with corner (1, 1) removed, leaving 63 squares, candidate tiling by twenty-one 1x3 trominoes
slots.Z: coloring invariant: color (i, j) with (i + j) mod 3; every 1x3 tromino covers exactly one square of each color; full board has counts (22, 21, 21); removing corner (1, 1) of color 2 leaves (22, 21, 20), violating the necessary condition of 21 of each color
slots.W: Every 1x3 tromino covers exactly one square of each color, but removing corner (1, 1) leaves color counts 22, 21, 20 instead of 21, 21, 21
slots.wrong_idea: claiming that since 63 is divisible by 3, a valid tiling must exist, or using a 2-color checkerboard which cannot constrain 1x3 trominoes
slots.replacement_rule: apply diagonal 3-coloring (i + j) mod 3; every straight 1x3 tromino covers {0, 1, 2}; color imbalance (22, 21, 20) rigorously precludes tiling
slots.visual_job: render 8x8 grid colored with 3 alternating diagonal colors, highlighting removed corner square; avoid unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: independent check: rotating the coloring by 90 degrees yields a symmetrical color discrepancy, confirming tiling impossibility.

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Deductive assertion or impossibility claim requiring formal justification
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 activates invariant/extremal framework; H2 establishes intermediate contradiction step; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; complete deductive proof with counterexample elimination
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student logical flaw or incomplete invariant

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or textual answer in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative justification pathway (e.g. horizontal line parity or coordinate polynomials)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item with identical deductive justification under modified dimensions

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item extending the justification to 3D grid cube decomposition
